title: OMA Harness DSL (v1/v2)
description: Single-source YAML surface for an OMA plugin. oma-compile reads this and emits .mcp.json and kiro-agents/<agent>.agent.json. Native runtimes (Claude Code marketplace, Kiro) consume the emitted files unchanged. v2 adds optional workflows (DAG), telemetry, policies, metadata, and loops sections without touching the emission contract.

version.description: DSL schema version. v1 = the original contract. v2 adds optional workflows/telemetry/policies/metadata blocks; v1 files continue to compile unchanged.

metadata.description: (v2 only) Optional Kubernetes-style metadata block. Used by harness consumers for labelling/filtering; the compiler itself ignores it.

workflows.description: (v2 only) Named workflow DAGs. Each step refers to an already-declared agent or skill. The compiler validates the DAG (no cycles, step refs resolve) but does not execute it; runtime wiring lands in a later release.

telemetry.description: (v2 only) OpenTelemetry Collector wiring. Consumers (autopilot, agenticops) emit spans/metrics/logs to these endpoints; the compiler only validates the shape.

policies.description: (v2 only) Declarative runtime-enforcement rules. Each entry carries an `enforce` block the compiler translates into hooks/harness-rules.json plus a PreToolUse entry in hooks/hooks.json, enforced by the bundled enforce.py before a tool runs. Pure Claude Code; no external policy engine.

loops.description: (v2 only) Named feedback loops. Each loop defines a cyclic sequence of skill steps with cadence, event triggers, severity-based gating, and explicit feedback edges. The compiler validates step references and feedback edges but does not execute them; runtime orchestration is handled by the Loop Controller.

plugin.description: Plugin id. Must match the directory name under plugins/.

mcp.description: MCP server definitions keyed by short id. Short ids are what agents.mcp[] references.

hooks.description: Harness hooks. Keys are Claude Code hook event names (session-start, pre-tool-use, ...).

triggers.description: Keyword triggers merged into .omao/triggers.json at compile time.

mcp.description: Short ids into the top-level mcp: map. Unknown ids are rejected by the compiler.

welcomeMessage.description: Kiro-specific welcome text. Passed through when runtime=kiro.

tools.description: Kiro tools allowlist. Passed through when runtime=kiro.

resources.description: Kiro resources list (file://, skill://...). Passed through when runtime=kiro.

notes.description: Free-form metadata block copied under `_meta` on the emitted agent.json.

mcpEnvOverrides.description: Per-mcp-id env overrides applied ONLY to the emitted Kiro agent.json (not the Claude Code .mcp.json).

args.description: Must contain a pinned version (==X.Y.Z). Compiler rejects floating versions.

runs.description: Path to the shell script, relative to the plugin root.

policyRef.description: (v2 only) A declarative runtime-enforcement rule. The compiler emits these into hooks/harness-rules.json plus a PreToolUse entry in hooks/hooks.json, so the bundled enforcer (tools/oma_harness/enforce.py) blocks matching tool calls before they run — pure Claude Code, no external policy engine.

enforce.description: Runtime deny rule evaluated by the PreToolUse hook. Fires when (tool matches or is omitted) AND every declared deny_if condition matches.

tool.description: Exact Claude Code tool name to match (e.g. Bash, Write, Edit). Omit to match any tool.

deny_if.description: Conditions that must all match for the rule to fire. At least one condition key is required.

decision.description: What the PreToolUse hook returns when the rule fires.

reason.description: Human-readable reason shown to the model when the call is blocked.

workflow.description: (v2 only) A named DAG of steps referencing declared agents or skills.

agent_ref.description: Id of an agent declared at agents[].id.

skill_ref.description: Id of a skill (resolved by the harness; not validated against the plugin file alone).

depends_on.description: Step ids in the same workflow that must complete first.

on_failure.description: How the harness should react if this step fails.

trigger.description: Keyword trigger descriptor compiled into .omao/triggers.json. The workspace hook hooks/user-prompt-submit.sh reads the emitted file to decide whether to surface a Tier-0 command suggestion.

id.description: Stable identifier used in hook logs.

keywords.description: Case-insensitive keywords or multi-word phrases. Any single match (with word boundaries for single tokens, substring for multi-word) fires the trigger.

context_required.description: Optional additional substrings that must all appear in the user's prompt before the trigger fires. Skipped when the user invokes an explicit slash command.

command.description: Slash command or skill id the keyword resolves to.

description.description: Human-readable one-liner surfaced to the agent when the trigger fires.

loop.description: (v2 only) A named feedback loop. Unlike a workflow (linear DAG), a loop defines cyclic execution with explicit feedback edges, cadence-based scheduling, event-driven triggers, severity-gated human approval, and layered termination logic. Follows the 4-layer stacking model: agent loop (skill internals) → verification loop (step-level retry) → event-driven loop (cadence/triggers) → hill-climbing loop (self-improving-loop).

mode.description: Loop execution mode. 'continuous' runs on cadence indefinitely (monitoring). 'event-driven' starts on trigger and exits when exit_when is satisfied (goal-oriented).

cadence.description: Cron expression or duration (e.g. '1h', '6h', '1d') for periodic execution. Required for continuous mode. Omit for purely event-driven loops.

trigger_on.description: Event-based triggers that start the loop (event-driven mode) or force an immediate iteration (continuous mode).

exit_when.description: Normal termination conditions (verifier.passes). When ANY condition is met, the loop exits successfully. For continuous loops this pauses until next cadence tick; for event-driven loops this completes the loop run.

max_iterations.description: Hard cap on consecutive iterations per run. Prevents infinite loops. After this many iterations without exit_when being satisfied, the loop escalates to human.

budget.description: Resource budget for the loop. Exhaustion triggers escalation to human.

no_progress_detection.description: Detects when the loop is stuck repeating the same state. Triggers escalation instead of burning resources.

feedback.description: Explicit feedback edges forming the cycle. Each entry is 'source_step_id -> target_step_id'.

circuit_breaker.description: Safety mechanism to halt the loop after consecutive failures.

escalation.description: Where to hand off when the loop cannot make progress or exceeds budget.

skill_ref.description: Skill id resolved at runtime by the harness.

depends_on.description: Step ids in the same loop that must complete before this step runs.

skip_remaining_if.description: Condition expression evaluated after this step completes. If true, all subsequent steps in this iteration are skipped and the loop returns to idle until next cadence/trigger. This is the Triage gate: 'no actionable items found, skip Modify and Verify'.

isolation.description: Execution isolation strategy for this step. 'worktree' runs in a separate git worktree (isolated branch). 'container' runs in a sandboxed container. 'none' runs in the main working directory.

gate.description: Approval gate for this step. Determines whether the step auto-executes or requires human approval based on severity.

on_failure.description: How the loop should react if this step fails.

timeout.description: Max execution time for this step in seconds.

loopGate.description: Severity-based approval gate. Low-severity actions auto-execute; high-severity actions require human approval.

type.description: Gate type: 'auto' always proceeds, 'human-approval' always pauses, 'severity-based' decides based on the severity field of the upstream signal.

auto_approve_below.description: For severity-based gates: severity levels at or below this threshold auto-approve. Valid values: low, medium, high, critical.

timeout_minutes.description: How long to wait for human approval before timing out (default: loop halts on timeout).

notify.description: Notification channels to alert when approval is needed.

loopTrigger.description: An event that can start a loop iteration outside the normal cadence.

loopCircuitBreaker.description: Halts the loop after repeated failures to prevent runaway execution.

consecutive_failures.description: Number of consecutive loop iteration failures before the circuit opens.

cooldown_minutes.description: How long the loop stays halted before attempting to close the circuit.

notify.description: Notification channels to alert when the circuit opens.

loopExitCondition.description: A condition that signals normal loop termination (verifier.passes). When satisfied, the loop exits successfully rather than continuing to iterate.

slo_restored.description: SLO restoration expression with duration (e.g. 'error_rate < 0.01 for 15m'). Exit when the condition holds for the specified duration.

goal_met.description: Goal-completion expression (e.g. 'all_tests_pass', 'deployment_100_percent'). Checked by the verifier step.

loopBudget.description: Resource budget for the loop. When any budget dimension is exhausted, the loop stops and escalates to human rather than continuing to burn resources.

max_token_spend.description: Maximum total tokens (input + output) the loop may consume per run.

max_cost_usd.description: Maximum USD cost the loop may incur per run.

max_wall_clock_minutes.description: Maximum wall-clock time in minutes for a single loop run.

loopNoProgress.description: Detects when the loop is stuck in a no-progress state (same error repeated, state unchanged). Triggers escalation instead of spinning indefinitely.

repeated_state_count.description: Number of consecutive iterations producing the same outcome (identical error, unchanged state hash) before declaring no-progress.

action.description: What to do when no-progress is detected.

loopEscalation.description: Defines where and how to hand off when the loop cannot make progress, exceeds budget, or hits max_iterations.

create_issue.description: Automatically create a GitHub/GitLab issue with loop state and trace.

include_trace.description: Include the full iteration trace in the escalation message.
